name: Fracturing Orb
description: Fracture a random modifier on a rare item with at least 4 modifiers, locking it in place.
directions: Right click this item then left click a rare item to apply it. Cannot be used on Fractured items.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a rare item to apply it. Cannot be used on Influenced, Synthesised or Fractured items.
